capability: Send the wiring of the code, not every file
title: Send the wiring, not the pile.

hook.picture: Close on the whale pushing a towering stack of file cards toward a pod; a cut line at the pod's mouth slices the stack, and most of it falls away.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Our codebase doesn't fit, so it guesses how things connect.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer asking an AI about a large repo

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the pile is enormous. Three more questions come, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the cut lands above the card that holds the answer.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Most of the pile never gets read.

stakes.body: Answers about how parts connect are guessed, and changes made on those answers break things.

solution_hint: Send how parts connect, not every line.

metaphor.body: Each file becomes a small card that keeps only its sockets and the wires between them; repeated wiring shapes fold into one pattern card with a key, so the whole map fits where the pile never did.

steps.picture: Each file card shrinks to a small card that shows only its sockets: what goes in, what comes out. The wires between sockets stay.
steps.sound: A tuned pluck per card, quick

steps.picture: The pile is now a small wiring map of cards and wires.
steps.words: Keep each part's sockets. Drop the insides.
steps.sound: The plucks settle into a chord

steps.picture: Five identical wiring shapes fold into one pattern card, with a small key card beside it.
Push-in: the whole small map passes the cut line with room to spare; the pod reads it and answers the link question with a tick.
steps.words: Same question. Now it sees the joints.

steps.picture: The pod asks for one file's insides; just that one card unfolds.
The sockets glow with their labels.
steps.words: Every socket says what it takes: typed.

real_case.claim: wiring-and-the-whole E3 pilot: A 93.8% vs B 95.3% vs C 0% on the wiring pool; B uses 63% of A's tokens. Conditions A, B and C are not defined on the README; not repo-scale savings.

honest_limit.picture: A pattern card carries one mark the key card never defines; the pod reads the whole small map, stops at that mark and answers with a cross.
honest_limit.words: Everything is there. The key is missing.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the same pod and the same cut line at its mouth. The small wiring pack slides in and the cut falls on open water; nothing is sliced, the pod answers with a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The cut that sliced the pile in bar 1 now cuts nothing, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Send the shape. Add files when asked.
